meta.title: Send the scored vendor for approval

steps.note: Open the prepared scored vendor proposal where the approval action is available.

args.goal: click Approve at the bottom, complete the Send for Approval side panel by adding Category and Location if needed, click Next, review the approval workflow, add remarks, select an approver, click Continue, and stop when the vendor is shown as pending approval

steps.note: Execute the buyer-side approval submission workflow and verify the screen proves the vendor was sent for approval.
Assert that the proposal now shows the expected pending approval state.
